name: domain
description: Keeps a team's glossary, decision log, open questions and requirements in linked Notion databases, sets them up, and gives each session an index of them.

interface.shortDescription: Glossary, decisions and requirements in Notion
interface.longDescription: Sets up and maintains a Glossary, Decisions log, Open questions and Requirements in Notion, teaches agents to read them before naming or building anything, and injects an index of them into each session.
defaultPrompt: Use the domain skill to set up our glossary, decisions and requirements in Notion.
Check the glossary before naming the new event.
